svg.title: Sethy Pagna UNG: សួស្តី · 你好 · Hello
svg.desc: Animated cyberpunk night scene in the rain: Angkor Wat on the left, the Hong Kong skyline with searchlights on the right, and a plane flying from KH (Cambodia) to HK (Hong Kong). Computer Science at PolyU; full-stack and AI apps; Unreal Engine prototypes.
